summary: Full backend + frontend regression on iPhone Settings Simulator (multi-device release). 14/14 pytest cases pass. All 7 UI scenarios pass: About renders 22 dynamic fields with no 'Loading', dialer *#06# opens the Device Information sheet with 3 real JsBarcode SVGs (each containing 38-47 <rect> nodes) and correct IMEI text, admin can see 2 seeded chips, session survives reload (JWT has no exp claim), switching Active reflects instantly on About & Phone, and add/edit/save/delete of a temporary device works end-to-end. Final DB state verified: exactly 2 devices, active IMEI 356789104532198.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py DEFAULT_DEVICES key 'seeid' is misspelled (should be 'seid'); propagates through About/Admin/Phone testIds ('about-seid' vs field 'seeid'). Cosmetic-only, but worth renaming with a small data migration.

AdminDashboard.remove() calls window.confirm implicitly? Actually it deletes without a confirm dialog; consider adding a confirm to prevent accidental deletion (currently a single click on delete-device-button removes the profile).

DeviceContext caches device in localStorage for instant render (great for 'no loading'), but there is no invalidation when admin edits or activates from another tab; refreshDevice() on mount mitigates on navigation only.

backend seeds admin only when missing and re-hashes when password differs — good. seed_devices only runs when collection is empty, so schema/field changes on existing DBs won't reflect until manually cleared.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@iphone.local / admin123 (per request; /app/memory/test_credentials.md not present)
seed_data_creation: Temporary 'Test Device' (IMEI 359999999999999) created during flow test and cleaned up. Final DB state has exactly 2 seeded devices with iPhone 16 Pro Max (IMEI 356789104532198) active.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py has been rewritten for the new multi-device schema (GET/POST /api/devices, PUT/DELETE /api/devices/{id}, POST /api/devices/{id}/activate, GET /api/device active). Run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0` (xdist parallelism breaks TestFinalState ordering; -n 0 forces sequential). Frontend UI selectors used: [data-testid] for about-*, barcode-*, key-*, phone-*, device-chip-<id>, device-list, add/activate/delete-device-button, admin-save-button, field-<key>. Barcodes: <svg> elements produced client-side by JsBarcode with ~38-47 <rect> children — assert children>0 or rects>0. Active-device switching requires re-navigation to /about or /phone (or refreshDevice on mount) for the cached_device in localStorage to refresh. Delete button on admin does NOT show a confirm() dialog, so no page.on('dialog') needed; keeping the handler is harmless.
rca of the issue: No issues encountered in this iteration.
